violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: dishes in dish machine dispensing 0 PPM of chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC wash, rinsed, and sanitized all dishes at 3 compartment sink.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed ice cream mix (48-50F) in ice cream/soft serve machine.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded ice cream mixture.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticides
violations.observation: Restricted use pesticides do not meet the requirements in 40 CFR 152 Subpart 1 Classification of Pesticides. Observed ‘Raid’ in facility.
violations.corrective_action: Restricted use pesticides that do not meet the requirements of 40 CFR 152 may be toxic, which may result in the contamination of food. These pesticides shall not be used. PIC discarded pesticide.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: observed non-NSF or equivalent steamer in use.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. Please obtain an NSF-rated or equivalent steamer.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: ice cream machine.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Observed ice cream machine holding TCS mixture above 41F. Please repair unit and submit documentation to EHS within 10 days.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed dish machine dispensing 0 PPM of chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Please contact a technician to repair unit. Please submit documentation of repair to EHS within 10 days.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: steamer observed not NSF or equivalent.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a steamer that is NSF or equivalent. Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Dishmachine observed not sanitizing- 0ppm. Of Chlorine observed. (Machine was not in use at time of inspection).
violations.corrective_action: Do not use the dishmachine until it has been repaired/serviced and 50-100ppm of Chlorine is provided. Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Backflow Prevention between Sewage System & Food Equip
violations.observation: A direct connection exists between the drain line of the dish machine and the sewer system.
violations.corrective_action: Correct within the next 72hrs. A direct connection may not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food, portable equipment, or utensils are placed.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention between Sewage System & Food Equip
violations.observation: Only an air break provided between the drain line of the sanitizing basin of the 3-compartment sink and the sewer line.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a min. 1” air gap as discussed within the next 72hrs. A direct connection may not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food, portable equipment, or utensils are placed.
